incoming_defects.title: Checkout payment fails after OTP confirmation
incoming_defects.description: Customers can enter card details and OTP, but after confirmation the checkout page shows a generic error. Orders are not created.
incoming_defects.logs: POST /payment/authorize 502 gateway timeout. provider_ref missing. impact: multiple users.

incoming_defects.title: Password reset link opens blank page on Safari
incoming_defects.description: Reset email is generated successfully. On Safari 17 the reset URL opens a blank screen after the token validation call.
incoming_defects.logs: TypeError: crypto.subtle undefined during reset-token verify. No production impact yet.

incoming_defects.title: Inventory quantity differs between cart and order summary
incoming_defects.description: When two users add the last item at the same time, cart still shows available while order summary blocks checkout.
incoming_defects.logs: stock_reservation conflict. retry_count=0. race condition suspected.

historical_defects.title: Payment authorization timeout after OTP approval
historical_defects.resolution: Added idempotency key and provider reference persistence.

historical_defects.title: Safari reset token screen fails during crypto validation
historical_defects.resolution: Moved validation to server route and added browser fallback.

historical_defects.title: Race condition during final stock reservation
historical_defects.resolution: Introduced reservation retry and locking around final quantity check.
